title: Frozen behavioural metric definitions for the G1 piston SAC/RLPD comparison
frozen_when: before any RLPD evaluation existed: SAC seed 1 was at episode 450/500 and runs/rlpd.json had not been created
derivation: thresholds come only from simulator trajectories and the demonstration reference. They are independent of which method produced a rollout and of comparative performance.

definitions.reach: task stage predicate: right fingertips within GRASP_RADIUS (0.045 m) of the barrel axis
definitions.grasp: task stage predicate: fingers AND thumb both within GRASP_RADIUS (opposing contact)
definitions.lift: task stage predicate: barrel raised LIFT_H (0.05 m) above rest, once grasp has occurred
definitions.carry: lift fired AND horizontal displacement >= 0.05 m
definitions.throw: lift fired AND horizontal displacement < 0.05 m
definitions.full_success: task terminal predicate: over the pot, above plate height, no longer rising

threshold_provenance.margin: 0.05 m is 4x below the least-transporting demonstration, so it is deliberately permissive

roles.note: lift_rate is explicitly demoted: it counts vertical throws as progress

precise_reading: late SAC is NOT simply "lift declined". Task-consistent carrying regressed (0.36 -> 0.12) while reward-exploiting throws emerged (0.04 -> 0.12).
must_not: these thresholds must not be retuned later in light of SAC/RLPD results

bookkeeping_489_vs_467.reason: one per executable episode. A replay transition needs (s, a, r, s'), and each episode's final chunk has no successor observation, so the loader takes len(actions)-1 per episode: 22 episodes -> 22 dropped chunks. The screen manifest counts stored chunks (489); the RLPD buffer counts usable transitions (467). No data was lost or filtered.
